name: RSS Feed
description: The stories of an RSS or Atom feed, one page per story, newest first.

properties.name: feeds
properties.title: Feeds
properties.description: The feeds a task can show. A task picks one by its name. Only http and https addresses; Test opens the address and reads it as a feed.

properties.name: feedCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Feeds
properties.description: The longest a downloaded feed is kept before it is asked for again. The site's own headers can shorten this, never lengthen it. A slide show also keeps its own list of stories until it is used up. 0: download every time.

properties.name: contentCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Downloads
properties.description: The longest a downloaded picture is kept and shared by every task before it is asked for again. The site's own headers can shorten this, never lengthen it. 0: download every time.

properties.name: contentCacheMB
properties.title: Downloads Pool Size
properties.description: The most disk the kept downloads of this data source may use. When it is full, the one used longest ago goes first.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Downloads After
properties.description: A kept download nobody has used for this many days is removed. 0: never.

properties.name: feed
properties.title: Feed
properties.description: Which feed to show. Add feeds in the RSS Feed data source settings.

properties.name: title
properties.title: Title
properties.description: The heading above each story. Empty: the feed's name.

properties.name: includeImages
properties.title: Include Images
properties.description: Show a story's picture when the feed has one.
